query:
UPDATE entity
                    SET kind = $3,
                        body = $4,
                        origin = $5,
                        origin_ref = $6,
                        version = $7,
                        deleted_at = NULL,
                        updated_at = now()
                    WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2
                    RETURNING
                        id,
                        kind,
                        tenant_id,
                        body as "body!: Json<Value>",
                        origin,
                        origin_ref,
                        version
